fields.name: variant
fields.description: Follow the variant naming scheme by SPDI.

fields.name: chr
fields.description: Chromosome, include 'chr' (e.g., chr12).

fields.name: pos
fields.description: Position in GRCh38.

fields.name: ref
fields.description: Reference allele (based on GRCh38 genome).

fields.name: alt
fields.description: Alternative allele (based on GRCh38 genome).

fields.name: effect_allele
fields.description: The effect allele used for defining effect_size and allele frequency.

fields.name: other_allele
fields.description: The other allele.

fields.name: dosage
fields.description: T/F whether imputed dosages were used in the regression.

fields.name: af
fields.description: Allele frequency of the effect allele within the dataset.

fields.name: maf
fields.description: Minor allele frequency of the variant within the dataset.

fields.name: mac
fields.description: Minor allele count of the variant within the dataset.

fields.name: ma_sample
fields.description: Number of samples carrying the minor allele of the variant within the dataset.

fields.name: chromatin_phenotype
fields.description: Chromatin phenotype in the format chr{chromosome}:{start_pos_in_b38}-{end_pos_in_b38}.

fields.name: chromatin_method
fields.description: Method used to define the chromatin phenotype (e.g., ATAC-Seq Peak).

fields.name: chromatin_as
fields.description: T if the analyses use allele-specific accessibility.

fields.name: sd_phenotype
fields.description: Standard deviation of phenotype (e.g., 1 if the phenotype is normalized as such).

fields.name: n_sample
fields.description: Number of samples used in the regression.

fields.name: n_cell
fields.description: Number of cells included in the analyses for single-cell data.

fields.name: conditional
fields.description: The round of conditional analyses if the statistics are from the conditional analyses (e.g., 2 if it is secondary analyses). If empty, it should be considered as the primary analyses.

fields.name: conditional_method
fields.description: Method used for the conditional analyses. Required if it is a conditional analysis.

fields.name: effect_size
fields.description: Beta coefficient from the regression.

fields.name: se_effect_size
fields.description: Standard error of beta coefficient from the regression.

fields.name: pval_nominal
fields.description: Nominal p value from the regression.

fields.name: log10p_nominal
fields.description: Log10(p value) from the regression. Sometimes useful when p values are really small.

fields.name: pval_perm
fields.description: Permutation p value.

fields.name: FDR
fields.description: False discovery rate after multiple testing correction.

fields.name: FDR_method
fields.description: Method used for multiple testing correction.

fields.name: significance
fields.description: T/F whether the association was determined as significant.

fields.name: PIP
fields.description: PIP from fine-mapping across cis-SNPs.

fields.name: PIP_method
fields.description: Method used for fine-mapping.

fields.name: CS
fields.description: T if the variant is included in a 95% credible set.

fields.name: interaction
fields.description: T if the statistics are from interaction analyses of any sort. F if the statistics represent the main effect of the variant.

fields.name: interaction_context
fields.description: Description on what context or interaction variables were used for testing the interaction effect.
